Example Town is a small town in Example County on the northern coast.

History

The town was founded by fishermen in 1820. It was granted a charter in 1851.[1] About 300 residents were killed in the flood of 1862.

The former mayor, John Example, was accused of embezzling council funds in 2019.

The town has had a public library since 1902.[citation needed]
